content.short: Advanced URL Analysis Prevents phishing efforts by intercepting them before your wallet is connected.
content.description: Cardano Shield is an open-source wallet extension backed by Project Catalyst Fund10 that helps protect users from phishing and risky transactions. The tool analyzes URLs before wallet connection, summarizes transaction risk, and uses machine learning modules plus community insight to flag suspicious activity. Its goal is to give Cardano users clearer security information before they sign or connect. Cardano Shield fits the ecosystem as a proactive safety layer for wallets and everyday dapp use too.
content.meta: Cardano Shield is an open-source wallet extension for phishing and transaction protection. Explore Cardano Shield on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
